Biologist Bret Weinstein appears on Tucker Carlson's podcast to argue that the World Health Organization hides a dark agenda. Weinstein, a former professor, became a sharp critic of global health bodies during the COVID years. Carlson gives him room to state the charge in full.

Weinstein questions who holds power at the WHO, how its rules could bind member nations, and what the pandemic taught him about expert rule. Carlson presses him on motive and proof. Whether a listener agrees or not, the segment states a strong case against handing health choices to distant officials, in the speakers' own words.
uslaw-usc-t2-s142k: Section 142k of Title 2 of the United States Code deals with the pay office of the Library of Congress. It sits in Chapter 5, on the Library of Congress. From 1 October 1989, a duty falls on the Librarian of Congress. The Librarian must take steps that are fit to guard a set of staff. Those staff are men of the legislative branch whose wages are paid by that office. No such man is to be hurt by new ways of doing staff and pay work.
